psychological_meaning: Punga, a deep and earthy brown, evokes feelings of stability, reliability, and connection to the natural world. It suggests groundedness and resilience, offering a sense of comfort and security. This color is often associated with maturity, sophistication, and a no-nonsense approach to life, symbolizing honesty and authenticity.
